title: Your Cat Won’t Appreciate These Prime Day Deals, but You Will
gist: WIRED's pet-tech Prime Big Deal Days roundup lists discounts of roughly 20–30% on tested pet cameras, automatic feeders, fountains and litter boxes from Petcube, Furbo, Petkit and Petlibro, with AI-enabled cameras increasingly standard in premium models.

insights.claim: Amazon Prime Day now happens several times a year, including the October Prime Big Deal Days, which the reviewer positions as a pre-Black Friday buying window for expensive pet tech.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Amazon has turned Prime Day into a recurring event, smoothing demand across the year rather than one July spike.
insights.quote: Amazon Prime Day now happens several times a year, including Prime Big Deal Days, which run through October 6 and 7.

themes.theme: AI and app connectivity in pet tech

insights.claim: Premium pet devices now commonly ship with AI-enabled cameras and connected apps — e.g. Petkit's YumShare Dual-Hopper 2 feeder and the Purobot Max Pro 2 litter box, which uses AI camera and app data to provide health insights.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Pet tech is a growing consumer category for computer-vision features and app-based monitoring.
insights.quote: It features an AI-enabled camera and a connected app to better track and monitor usage, providing enhanced health insights.
insights.locator: This is the best overall automatic litter box

insights.claim: The reviewer recommends that every cat owner buy an automatic litter box and every pet owner an automatic feeder, despite their high price.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Reviewer advocacy supports mainstreaming of $300–$500 pet appliances.
insights.quote: Although they are pricey, I recommend that every single cat parent invest in an automatic litter box.

insights.claim: Discounts on tested pet tech cluster around 20–30%: Petkit PuraMax 2 at $282 (28% off), Purobot Max Pro 2 at $443 (19% off), Furbo 360 at $85 (30% off) on Amazon.
insights.speaker: Molly Higgins
insights.so_what: Moderate, not deep, discounting on pet devices suggests healthy demand in the category.
